Yes. The 2022 tree-cover loss at ASSET-I (17.6 ha rural property) is corroborated under the method used.

- **Hansen/UMD:** about 0.6 ha of tree-cover loss was mapped in 2022, roughly 3.4% of the asset.
- **JRC GFC2020 reference:** it shows forest in 2020 over 100% of the event area, which clears the 50% agreement threshold.
- **Later observation:** the series runs to 2025, so a later year was observed for this event, which the rule also requires.
- **Forest context:** the MGAP 2021 map puts about 0.5 ha of the area in native forest and 0.1 ha outside mapped forest. No planted forest was found.

A further 0.2 ha of loss in patches under 0.5 ha was seen in 2022. It is not counted as an event.

This confirms that tree cover was lost. It does not establish deforestation or land-use change, the cause, legality, who was responsible, or any compliance finding.
